rows.en: This will be our final operation.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Poseidal keeps feeding the world the sparks of war, bent on keeping the fighting going.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Unless we strike here, we will never end this long war that has dragged on and on.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Manipulating others to keep a war going must never be allowed to pass.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The enemy's strength may be down, but don't forget this is their home base. Stay alert.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: This time, let us win a true peace for good.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The true Oldna Poseidal is dead, and the Poseidal Army has agreed to surrender.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: With Poseidal, who drove the war, now dead, the fighting is dying down everywhere.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Thanks to all of your efforts, the road to ending the war has been laid.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The time for our fight to be rewarded, an age of peace, has finally come.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: I want to hand the foundations of the next era to the young, Miss Relena among them.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Peace now rests on all of you. Do not forget that as you fight.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)
